childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_1: Abana bavutse baba bafite ubushobozi buke bwo kubona. Mu by'ukuri baba nk'abatabona. Ariko uko kubona kwabo gukomeza gutera imbere mu myaka 5 kugeza kuri 8 ikurikiraho, impinduka nini zikaboneka cyane cyane mu mezi 18 ya mbere y'ubuzima. Iyi ni igihe cy'ingenzi cyane.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_2: Muri iki gihe, uburyo bwo kubona bukorwa n'amaso n'ubwonko bugomba kuba buzima kandi bugaterwa imbaraga. Iki ni cyo gihe cyiza cyo kumenya indwara no kohereza umuntu kuvurirwa.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_titl: Impamvu n'uburyo tumenya indwara kugira ngo iyerekwa rikure neza kurushaho
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_body: Indwara iyo ari yo yose yo mu jisho cyangwa mu bwonko izadindiza imikurire kandi igabanye iyerekwa ry'igihe kirekire. Ni yo mpamvu ari ngombwa kumenya hakiri kare impamvu z'indwara zishobora kuvurwa zibangamira imikurire isanzwe y'iyerekwa n'iterambere rusange.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_question_bubble: Ibi bishobora gukorwa ubajije ibibazo ku iyerekwa, gutwita, kuvuka, indwara izo ari zo zose n'iterambere rusange
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_observe_copy: Hanyuma reba amaso usuzume imikurire y'iyerekwa, ubone gusuzuma indwara z'amaso ukoresheje ikizamini cya fundal 'red' reflex no gusuzuma igice cy'imbere cy'ijisho
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_paragr: Imbere mu nda, uruhinja rutaravuka ruzengurutswe nijwi ryoroheje kandi rituje, harimo umutima wa nyina ndetse n'amajwi n'amajwi aturuka ku isi yo hanze.
Iyo gutwita bigeze ku ndunduro yanyuma, amaso yumwana arashobora gukingura imbere munda.
Mugihe badashobora kubona amashusho cyangwa ibisobanuro, barashobora kumva impinduka mumucyo.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_image_: Icyiciro cyo gutwita cyerekana umwana utaravuka munda
Icyiciro cyo gutwita cyatinze cyerekana kumenya urumuri
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_2_paragr: Kubyara kubyara ntaho bitaniye cyane nabakuze. Umwana wavutse ni 'impumyi' afite ubushobozi buke bwo kubona neza hafi 6/600. Ntibumva ibara ryinshi kandi bafite itandukaniro rito. Ntabwo bafite stereovision kandi amaso yabo arashobora guhubuka nonaha.
Bazareba ariko mu maso harehare cyane, kandi bahanze amaso kumatara yaka. Icyerekezo cyabo guhera ubu kigiye gutera imbere byihuse kandi gihinduke nkumuntu mukuru kumyaka 8.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_3_paragr: Mugihe cibyumweru bibiri iyerekwa ryateye imbere cyane. Ubu barashobora kubona amakuru arambuye, cyane cyane niba ibintu biri hafi. Nta bara kandi ibyo babona birasa, kuko amaso yabo atarahora agororotse kandi akorera hamwe kugirango yumve neza.
Rimwe na rimwe, amaso yabo azagenda cyangwa asohoka mugihe gito. Ibi byitwa guswera. Ibi bigomba guhagarika kubaho amezi atatu.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_paragr: Ukwezi kumwe ibara ryerekanwe ritangiye gutera imbere. Bazashishikazwa cyane cyane cyane mumaso. Bazatangira kandi kugerageza gukurikira ibintu bigenda.
Bazarushaho kumenya amajwi amenyerewe harimo amajwi azwi nkumuryango wabo. Kandi utangire guhuza ibyo bumva nibyo babonye.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_image_: Iterambere ryibonekeje hagati yibyumweru bibiri nukwezi
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_paragr: Mugihe cyamezi atatu amaso yabo agomba guhora agororotse kandi agakorera hamwe kugirango akore icyerekezo cya 3D. Ubu buryo bushya bwimbitse bubafasha kugera kubintu neza. Bazashobora gukurikira ibintu bigenda byihuse ariko biragoye guhindura fixation kuva mumaso imwe cyangwa ikintu ujya mubindi byihuse.
Bakunda kureba ikintu kimwe icyarimwe. Bashobora kandi gutangira gukora amajwi yabo ya mbere afite ireme.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_image_: Iterambere rigaragara hagati yukwezi kumwe nagatatu
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_6_paragr: Uruhinja rufite icyerekezo gisanzwe rukura ruzashimishwa no kubona igikombe cyo kunywa cyangwa ikiyiko kandi rushobora gukosora no gukurikira isura intera ya metero 1-2 kimwe no gushobora gutandukanya amasura amenyerewe kandi atamenyerewe mumaso yabo nijwi ryabo.
Barashobora kandi gutangira kubona ibintu biri kure. Bitewe namatsiko, bazatangira kugera kubintu.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_7_paragr: Ku mezi 6 kugeza 12 y'amavuko uburibwe bwo kureba buratera imbere kandi ni 6/36. Intera ireba kandi ikamenyekana yageze kuri metero 2. Ibintu byose byerekezo biratera imbere hamwe nukuri kugerwaho no gusobanukirwa.

Muri iki kigero baragenda bashishikazwa cyane namashusho mubitabo no kuri tereviziyo, nubwo ibintu bifatika bikurura cyane kubashishikariza gukurura no kuzenguruka isabukuru yabo ya mbere, bagenda bagana ibintu bishimishije. Ibibondo byabo biratera imbere, kandi amajwi azaba amagambo yambere kuriyi myaka.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_paragr: Mugihe cyamezi 18, iyerekwa irakuze rwose nkaho ikiri mubi kubijyanye no kubona neza nka 6/18. Ubu bazashobora kumenya izina ryabo kandi bakoreshe amagambo menshi kandi menshi.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_image_: Iterambere rigaragara hagati y'amezi cumi n'abiri n'umunani
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_paragr: Nyuma y'amezi 18 iyerekwa iracyakeneye imyaka myinshi kugirango ikure. Ubusanzwe abantu bakuze biboneka bazashiraho bafite imyaka 8.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_image_: Iterambere rigaragara hagati y'amezi cumi n'umunani n'imyaka umunani
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_10_parag: Nyuma yimyaka 8 sisitemu yo kureba ntishobora gutera imbere neza kuvura nko kubaga cataracte. Kumenya indwara no kohereza kubuvuzi rero nibyiza gukorwa hakiri kare mubuzima bushoboka.

Birashobora kugaragara ko iterambere ryinshi riba hagati yo kuvuka n'amezi 18 y'amavuko kandi rigakomeza buhoro buhoro mugihe gisigaye cy'ubwana. Muri iki gihe ni ngombwa ko umwana agira ubuzima bwiza hamwe na sisitemu yo kutabona neza kandi ikanahabwa ibidukikije bikangura kandi byubaka.
Kumenya hakiri kare indwara hamwe no koherezwa kuvurwa ni ngombwa kugirango bifashe kwaguka haba mu iterambere no muri rusange.
